# Official OKF fixtures

These bundles are copied from
`GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog/okf/bundles` at commit
`3fcbb9f828c2f23d109c855ee403c3a4c81f3a96`.

They are interoperability fixtures, not a claim that every checked-in file
passes the normative OKF v0.2 conformance rules. In particular, the Acme
Retail `log.md` carries frontmatter even though the specification reserves
log files for the date-grouped Markdown structure.

Generated `viz.html` files are omitted. See the repository root
`LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
